why: The mission NUMBER is resolvable only here: `run.ts` holds a level id and deliberately never imports campaign data, and the HUD names no simulation module at all, so a page that does not resolve it leaves the Main Menu's confidence line permanently degraded to the lives half for every player. It also feeds the replace-run confirmation's copy, which is what stops that question being about runs in general. Re-anchored for issue #555, which removed the `total` line this find string carried: the summary no longer names the campaign's length, so the only number the page still resolves is the position. That removal is also why there is no sibling entry putting the denominator BACK -- `CampaignRunSummary` has nowhere to carry it, which is the point of taking the field out rather than leaving it unread. The unplaceable-level case is no longer a killer HERE and has its own entry (`route-host-invents-a-position-for-an-unplaceable-level`) instead: with `total` gone this mutation's payload is `{ mission: null, lives }`, which is byte-for-byte what the real code produces for a level the campaign does not list, so that test cannot see it. Splitting the two keeps both nets rather than dropping one -- each entry now names the single defect its killer actually proves.
killedBy: createRouteHost: the Main Menu is painted from the stores by the page resolves the run summary the Main Menu shows, mission NUMBER included (issue #226)
